description: This file defines custom exception classes related to 'already exists' errors in Spark SQL analysis, such as database, table, view, function, index, and temporary table exceptions.

classes.name: DatabaseAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a database already exists.

classes.name: NamespaceAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception for namespace (schema) already existing, extends AnalysisException.

classes.name: TableAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception for table or view already existing, extends AnalysisException.

classes.name: TempTableAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception for temporary table or view already existing, extends AnalysisException.

classes.name: ViewAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception for view already existing, extends AnalysisException.

classes.name: FunctionAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception for function/routine already existing, extends AnalysisException.

classes.name: IndexAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Exception for index already existing, extends AnalysisException.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Various constructors for each exception class, initializing with relevant parameters such as names, identifiers, or cause.
